title: literal transfer of the 534brn page's 180-degree cue
authorial_cue: Experiment 413 shows the page footer itself must be read under a 180-degree rotation to yield '128 UNSOLVED'.
conclusion: The same 534brn page now independently proves that orientation reversal/rotation is part of its authorial grammar, but literal 180-degree transfer does not reproduce any one-shot state even under the six preregistered q gauges. This strengthens operation-family provenance without fixing the successful transpose + q-reversal parameter.
